method: Open weights: HF API (sort=trendingScore, and author=<lab> sort=createdAt for 38 lab orgs), filtered to createdAt inside the window; params = safetensors.total (or gguf.total) from the HF API; licence = cardData.license. Runtime check: the GGUF general.architecture must appear in ggml-org/llama.cpp src/llama-arch.cpp (master, read 2026-09-28), and the Ollama manifest (registry protocol on huggingface.co or registry.ollama.ai) must carry a chat template. Frontier API: lab primary pages only (Anthropic newsroom + pricing doc, OpenAI API changelog/model page/pricing doc, Google Gemini API changelog + pricing, DeepSeek API news + pricing, xAI models doc, Mistral changelog). A date shown as HF createdAt is the lab repo creation date, which is the primary record we could read; where a lab blog gives a date it is cited instead.

kaggle_budget.hardware: 2x Tesla T4, 16 GB each (kernel HALTs on anything else)
kaggle_budget.rule_used: fits = weights file <= ~10 GB (one T4 with KV-cache headroom; the mill runs one model at a time) AND llama.cpp supports the architecture AND a public ungated GGUF with a chat template exists. Measured anchor: qwen2.5:7b (4.7 GB) ran all 14 axes, 887 items, in 1,225 s kernel wall on 2026-09-28.
kaggle_budget.cap_source: run.sh QUOTA_CAP_H (trailing-7-day kernel wall recorded by the job; Kaggle's own GPU quota is ~30 h/week)

frontier_cost_assumptions.token_basis: measured: the week's Kaggle slices' Ollama prompt_eval_count and eval_count over all 887 bank items (see token_basis in the report JSON)
frontier_cost_assumptions.note: Floor = no reasoning tokens (label answers <=128 tokens, swarm <=1024). With-reasoning = floor + 1,000 reasoning tokens per item billed as output: an ASSUMPTION for budgeting, not a measurement. The mill instrument has no API transport today: intake requires an ollama:<tag>@<manifest digest> subject, and an API model has no manifest digest to pin, so any API run is a new instrument that needs its own design and owner ruling before its cards could exist. Sending frozen public banks to a vendor API also exposes them to that vendor.
